title: PhD Research Fellow in Social Science - Arctic Security and Preparedness
institution: Nord University, Faculty of Social Sciences
about: Nord University's Faculty of Social Sciences in Bodø, Norway, is recruiting 1-2 PhD Research Fellows in Social Science specialising in Arctic Security and Preparedness. Applications are submitted through the Jobbnorge portal by 4 January 2027.

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity

seniority "PhD candidates" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
